If possible I would suggest with any installer holding a final payment until the system is connected as promised.James' electrician installer was excellent, and has helped substantially since. Initial install was June 2022. The problem started because we are in a townhouse complex which complicated the application for connection. I helped substantially with this providing the required information but the application was never completed. I ended up chasing James for over a year with weekly (literally) text messages and emails where he promised to get things sorted, then compensate me for the feed-in I had lost, but we only spoke about three times and he continued to not do as promised. Eventually over a YEAR after install I thankfully had the electrician's contact who helped me process the connection - after enquiring I found there were unpaid applications that were incomplete. Not only this, but I ended up completing the meter upgrade application myself with my retailer once feed in had been approved. Eventually I got the system correctly connected with the meter upgrade this January.I have had installs before and thought I knew a lot about solar and installation, but got badly let down in this process. Thank goodness I was able to find a work around.

We purchased a large expensive system, no issues with the installing of the system, however after sales service is rubbish.  The Sungrow inverter failed within 2 years, lots of blame game where the issue was with and who should fix it and provide the refund because the system was down for 6 months. After months of saying it could not be the system the electricity company sent out an independent inspector, it turned out to be the inverter, no real surprises there, we told Forwood it was the inverter months prior.  Part of their sales promotion was they would know if the system failed and would be in contract with us, turns out this was a mistruth, they do not and did not make contact with us.  We found out the invertor was not working after receiving high electricity bills.  It took months and lots of follow up from me for the inverter to be replaced.  I phoned, emailed or texted constantly.We were told not to worry about it as we would be reimbursed for the 6 months the inverter was out of order.  As requested, I sent copies of our electricity bills multiple times to Forwood Energy.  I phoned, texted and emailed them nearly every day for months for our reimbursement. Every excuse in the book was provided.  It is with the accounts department, I am overseas, I am unwell, I am in a meeting and will phone you back (he rarely phoned me back), I will call you first thing in the morning (never happened) , I promise you I am onto it, I will square it instantly, I am on a roof, I will pay it out of my own bank account as a goodwill gesture, I am waiting to be reimbursed by Sungrow, I have this prioritised, I will process the refund instantly for you now, I have been away and will send it to our accounts area today they will send a remittance. YAWNIt has been over 10 months now, of course the refund was never received.  Forwood have been given ample opportunity to rectify the issue and refund our money.  All I got in return was lots of excuses and mistruths.  I am extremely disappointed in them.  They are all talk, if you need aftersales service this company is not for you.
